_comment: BrainQuest config — the single source of truth for WHERE the vault is and HOW to read it (path, harvested headings, tag scheme, tutor areas) plus the AI tutor backend. The Settings page (/settings) writes the vaultPath and the tutor section here; nothing else is written and the vault itself stays read-only. API keys never live here — they go in local/.env. Override the path per-machine with the BRAINQUEST_VAULT_PATH env var (the repo is synced via GitHub, so this absolute path is machine-specific). This ships as an EXAMPLE config — set vaultPath and areas.labels to your own vault. Any omitted section falls back to the defaults baked into lib/vault/config.ts.
